verdict.rationale: Better Auth is code-first: the homepage says there are "no dashboard clicks" and auth lives in code. Every capability, including sign-up, 2FA, organizations, API keys and admin operations (create users, roles, ban, impersonate), is exposed through client methods and server-side `auth.api` methods. Community reports add friction: admin scripts and tests felt hacky because of the request-header-based design, and the client library is JS-only with little guidance for writing other clients. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found none), documented non-JS client access, smoother header-free server/admin API use, and confirmation of parity with the hosted dashboard hinted at on the homepage.
